$comment.purpose: W34 contour identification; probe only; no canonical bed changes.
$comment.colours: Circular 120x44 anchor carries eight greys and six chromatic solids.
$comment.structure: Eight encoded gradients, four matched local-colour steps, pitches 4/16/64.
$comment.geometry: Six matched geometry contrasts over grey128, white and red; full colour product declined.
$comment.controls: Every backdrop has a no-glass reference; seven paths have both opaque high-contrast fills. Controls captured in light only, separately in both poses/scales; these are native-only.
$comment.phase: UNREACHABLE at both scales by scratch capture. No window-origin workaround. Phase evidence hash bf0155e0e73f40806d18af98bf0bf8cf7fde7568753de94367ab5930a1fa88cf
$comment.bridge: Canonical capsule over light-solid, dark-solid, photo and checkerboard; canonical holdout twins audited before split.
$comment.split: All fixture roles probe. Identification uses the pinned wave-local split and wave.py, never bare --set probe.
$comment.sentinels: Grey128 and checkerboard circular anchor also run three times at initial-settle8 with seed3401; normal seven-run sitting remains separate.

checkerboard-4.$comment: The finest pitch: below every plausible kernel width, so the material's response to it is flat and the cell reads the passband's far end.

checkerboard.$comment: Spec-mandated. Every cell edge is a step edge, so one capture yields many edge-spread samples for blur system identification.

checkerboard-64.$comment: Four times the canonical pitch. At this pitch the thin surfaces still read 2.00-2.10 device px while the thick ones read 6.00-6.75, which is the separation the wave is fitted on; rrect-sm is 64 px wide and centred, so it lies inside one uniform cell and its reading there is geometry rather than material.

light-solid.$comment: System light grey. The flat case: no backdrop detail, so tint and rim read alone.

dark-solid.$comment: System dark. Pairs with the dark-scheme profiles.

photo.$comment: A deterministic multi-frequency colour field rather than a real photograph: it carries broadband detail and saturated hue transitions (what a photo contributes to a glass diff) with no licensed asset and no decode differences between the two renderers.

capsule-button.$comment: The canonical control. Capsules are exact in vitrea's field family (S2), so this scene isolates material error from corner error.
